name_en: Basashi — thinly sliced raw horse meat dipped in sweet soy sauce
summary_ja: 薄く切った生の馬肉を、たまねぎやしょうがなどの薬味とともに甘口醤油で食べる熊本の名物。加藤清正が朝鮮出兵中に軍馬を食べたのが始まりとされ、阿蘇地域では戦後の食糧難で広まったという。
summary_en: Thin slices of raw horse meat are eaten with grated ginger, onion, and sweet soy sauce — a Kumamoto specialty said to trace back to Kato Kiyomasa eating his own war horses during a Korean campaign, later spreading around Aso in the postwar food shortage.
